page.layout: One page of index in two parallel columns (left and right), with a centred title "INDEX." above them. Lines are given row by row, left column then right column on each row. The catchword sits at the lower right.

page.notes: The two columns are parallel and cannot be fully separated with certainty; the pairing of numbers with entries on some rows (notably the 430 and 172 on the pontifex row, and the 349 and 228 lines) is uncertain and follows the printed rows. "Ioannes Cremensis", "luxuriosiß." and "Ioannes de Ianduno" lines are reconstructed from faint print. Lower right of the page is a catchword fragment "ioan" with a bullet. The page is faded with show-through from the reverse; damaged readings are not marked with [?] in the text above and should be checked against the scan.
